scope: manual acceptance candidate; no stable-release claim
onlyPostFullSuiteChange: pkg/server/stream.go: skip unused membership-signature JSON work outside nonempty workspace selectors; targeted race5PASS, no CPU benefit claim
startup: Server.ConfigureWorkspace(dataDir, explicitLegacyContext, legacyNamespace string) error, before Register; EnableReplay if used is called first

storage.backup: workspace.json.bak; previous valid revision, atomic write+fsync
storage.invalidOrFuture: error without reset; externally replaced invalid/revision data not overwritten
storage.legacy: explicit context only, first creation only; empty context starts empty
storage.exportImport: no credential/host-file fields; context binding removed, imported IDs remapped, connections unbound; imported relationships are configured/user-imported

http.mutations: same-origin/auth cookie +X-KubeView-Workspace-Nonce +revision; allowed in server read-only for application configuration
http.body: {revision, connection|harbor|relation}; all mutations return direct current document
http.scope: X-KubeView-Workspace/Harbor/Tab or workspaceId/harborId/tabId; configured production cannot bypass through old unscoped endpoints; /contexts and workspace bootstrap remain global
http.grant: per cookie+workspace+harbor+tab; current client generation/context/scope nonce; scope/credential changes cancel/revoke; preferences/rename retain identity
http.clusterWrites: X-KubeView-Cluster-Impact: acknowledged plus normal management+Kubernetes RBAC; capabilities probes remain read-only

stream.broker: shared raw informer by connectionRef+credential generation+GVR+exact namespace, subscriber projection; current list/watch SSAR before every new binding
stream.protocol: existing G00/opaque RV/UID/delete/relist preserved; RESOURCE_EVENT OUT_OF_SCOPE metadata only, not DELETE
stream.offline: SNAPSHOT.outOfScope only previously published UIDs from that operator scope which still exist outside membership; no outsider UID inventory
stream.relationships: label/template/owner UID chain/service dependencies; owner membership changes project child updates without child RV change, using shared cache in WS hot path
stream.revokeLimit: new subscribers are checked; established Kubernetes watch is not claimed to revoke instantly

traffic.http: repeated harborIds=idA&harborIds=idB for explicit same-connection union; omitted means active harbor only; GET/DELETE use same set
traffic.authorization: every chosen harbor must exist and use same connectionRef; explicit namespace list SSAR+same-credential Pod reads; full selector union before endpoint metadata history; no empty all-namespace fallback for explicit sets
traffic.response: namespaceScopes +authorizedHarborIds; existing provider UID/TLS binding and temporal endpoint mapping remain
traffic.evidence: unit synthetic metadata/flow contract only for new multi-namespace path; current real Hubble regression still requires a separate lease

validation.firstFailure: retained backend-first-unit.jsonl; offline relist fake tracker mixed typed/unstructured rows; fixture corrected, no runtime fix
validation.sourceBeforeAfter: equal within both corrected job and guard job

limits: These results are unit/fake/race/fuzz, not real Kubernetes or real flow proof.
Historical v1.1 API/provider/performance evidence is not automatically a current workspace PASS.
Root frozen vertical01 embedded binary predates the null-collection normalization and final membership-work guard; its normal UI evidence remains tied to its own source manifest.
V11 physical feedback/CPU/stable gates remain open; manual user acceptance remains pending.
